Re: Dispute regarding Account ACC-897135

We acknowledge receipt of your dispute regarding the account referenced above. You have disputed the debt as already paid. We take all disputes seriously and will investigate this matter in accordance with the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA) and Florida state law.

We have reviewed the account history and confirm that the original creditor was Horizon Card Co. The account was charged off on 2022-01-09. Your last payment date was 2022-01-29, and the current balance is 6176.5.

As per your request, we will provide validation of the debt. We will send you a written validation notice within the next 5 days, as required by the FDCPA. This notice will include the amount of the debt, the name of the creditor, and a statement that unless you dispute the debt within 30 days after receiving the notice, we will assume the debt is valid.

Please note that we will not continue collection efforts until we have provided the validation notice and you have had an opportunity to dispute the debt.

You have the right to dispute this debt further if you believe it is incorrect. If you wish to dispute the debt, please respond to this letter within 30 days.

Sincerely,

[AGENCY NAME]

Please note that this letter only addresses the dispute as presented and does not address the consumer's additional claims regarding the original creditor or state law.
